slides.headline: She started on a factory floor. She now runs a $27.9 billion company - and is about to spin off another.
Revathi Advaithi, CEO of Flex Ltd., is spinning off a new AI-data-center power company
slides.body: Advaithi rose from an entry-level factory-floor supervisor role to lead Flex, a $27.9 billion global manufacturing giant, and in May 2026 announced she would lead a spin-off, Axiom Solutions International, built around Flex's booming power business for AI data centers.

slides.headline: The new company's power segment grew 38% year-over-year to $6.6 billion.
slides.body: Born and educated in India, Advaithi worked her way up through operations roles across multiple manufacturing companies before reaching Flex's top job - and the segment she's spinning off now sits squarely inside the global AI infrastructure boom.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: From supervising a factory floor to launching a company built for the AI era.
slides.body: Advaithi's path runs through decades of operations work most executives skip - and lands her leading a business at the center of the infrastructure race behind every AI data center being built today.
